description: Batched FP32 GEMM using cuBLAS (NVIDIA) or rocBLAS (AMD). Computes C[i] = alpha * A[i] * B[i] + beta * C[i] for i in [0, batch_count). Each matrix is M×K * K×N (row-major, FP32). Reports aggregate GFLOPS.

scaling_param.name: matrix_dim
scaling_param.description: Square matrix dimension M=N=K for each batch element

non_scaling_params.name: batch_count
non_scaling_params.description: Number of independent GEMM operations in the batch
